Yahweh will protect you in everything that you do. {He will do that} now, and {he will do that} forever.
A psalm for people going up to the temple to worship. This is a psalm of David. I was very happy when people said to me, “We should go to Yahweh’s temple {in Jerusalem}!”
Now we are standing inside the gates of Jerusalem.
This is Jerusalem, the city that people have built in a way that everything fits closely together.
The tribes of Israel who belong to Yahweh go there, as Yahweh told them to do, in order to thank him.
Indeed, the kings who belong to King David’s family sit on their thrones there and judge {the people}.
Pray that people will live peacefully in Jerusalem! May those who love Jerusalem be successful.
May everyone inside the city walls live well and prosper.
Because I love my fellow Israelites and my friends, I want to say, “May the people in Jerusalem live well.”
Because Yahweh our God has his temple there, I intend to always do what is best for Jerusalem.
A psalm for people going up to the temple to worship. Yahweh, I look up toward you who live in heaven.

You see, just as servants watch their master closely, waiting for him to provide for them, and just as a female servant watches her mistress, in the same way, we look to Yahweh our God, waiting for him to be merciful to us.
Yahweh, please be very merciful to us, because people have despised us so much that we cannot endure any more.
We have endured far too much mocking from people who are arrogant, yes, from proud people who despise us.
A psalm for people going up to the temple to worship; of David. If Yahweh had not been helping us— All Israelites should repeat this—
If Yahweh had not been helping us when our enemies attacked us,
then they would have destroyed us completely, because they were so angry with us.
They would have overwhelmed us like a flood; they would have swept over us like a raging river.
{They would have destroyed us as completely as} raging waters would have drowned us.
We praise Yahweh because he did not let our enemies destroy us as wild animals devour their prey.
We escaped from them like a bird that gets free from a hunter’s trap. It was as though the trap broke, and, as for us, we went free!
Yahweh is the one who helps us; he is the one who made everything that exists.
A psalm for people going up to the temple to worship. People who trust in Yahweh are as secure as Mount Zion, which will stand firm forever.
Just as the hills surrounding Jerusalem protect the city, so Yahweh protects his people, and he will protect them forever.
Indeed, wicked people will not rule over the land that God gave to righteous people, so that righteous people will not start doing what is wrong.
Yahweh, please do good things for people who do good things for others, yes, for those who obey you sincerely.
But as for those people who choose to do evil things, Yahweh will send them away along with everyone else who does evil things. May Yahweh bless the people of Israel!
A psalm for people going up to the temple to worship. When Yahweh brought us back to Zion after our enemies had captured us {and taken us away}, we felt as if we were dreaming.
We laughed and shouted joyfully. Then people from other people groups said about us, “Yahweh has done great things for them!”
{Yes!} Yahweh {truly} has done great things for us, and we are very happy.
Yahweh, restore us as before our enemies captured us, as you restore the streams in the Negev {that flow again after being dry}.
Those who sow seeds while crying will shout joyfully when they gather the harvest.
They may indeed walk {through the field} crying, as they spread the seed from their bags. But they will surely come back shouting joyfully, carrying their bundles of grain.

This is a psalm for people going up to the temple to worship. It is of Solomon. If people are building a house, but Yahweh does not approve of it, those who build it are doing nothing useful. If Yahweh does not protect a city, it is useless for the guards to stay awake watching it.
It is useless for you to get up very early and stay up very late, working hard to get food, because Yahweh wants to give sleep to those whom he loves.
Children are a gift that Yahweh gives; Offspring are a benefit {from him}.
When a man has sons while he is still young, those sons become as useful as arrows are in the hand of a warrior.
A man who has many sons has such a good life! When he argues with an opponent at the place where people settle disputes, the opponent will not defeat him.
This is a psalm for those going up to the temple to worship. How good life is for all who deeply revere Yahweh and who do what he tells them to do!
You will enjoy eating the food that you have worked hard for, and it will make you healthy.

Your wife will bear many children in the innermost rooms of your house, like a grapevine that produces many grapes. Your children will grow strong like young olive trees as they fill the room around your table.
Yes, that is how Yahweh will bless every person who deeply reveres him.
May Yahweh bless you from {where he lives} in Zion, so that you may be able to experience how the people of Jerusalem prosper during the whole time that you live,
and so that you may live long enough to see your grandchildren! May the people of Israel live well!
A psalm for people going up to the temple to worship. Ever since I was young, my enemies have oppressed me frequently. All of the people of Israel should say this {with me}:
Ever since I was young, my enemies have oppressed me frequently, but they have never defeated me!
{They oppressed me severely as though} they were plowing across my back, making long wounds like furrows in a field.
Yahweh does what is right; he no longer allows wicked people to control me.
May everyone who hates the people of Zion be ashamed and go away.
May they be {as insignificant} as the grass that grows on the rooftops that dries up before anyone can pull it out,
that no harvester would {bother to} pick up and that no one gathering bundles would {want to} wrap his arms around {to tie it up}.
They will never hear someone walking by {the reapers} say, “May Yahweh bless you!” {They will not hear the reapers reply,} “We bless you as representatives of Yahweh.”
This is a psalm for people going up to the temple to worship. Yahweh, I am very distressed, so I call out to you.
Lord, please listen to me; please listen attentively as I call out to you to have mercy on me!
Yahweh, if you kept a record of {the} sins {that we have committed}, Lord, you would have to condemn and punish every one of us!
But you forgive us, with the result that we deeply revere you.
Yahweh has said {that he would help me}; I trust what he said, and so I wait eagerly for him {to do that}.
I wait for the Lord {to help me} more {eagerly} than watchmen wait for the morning {to come}; yes, I wait more eagerly than watchmen wait for the morning!
{My fellow} Israelites, confidently expect that Yahweh will help us. {He will help us} because he faithfully loves us, and he is very willing to save us.
It is he who will make it so he will not need to punish {us} Israelite people for all the sins that {we} have committed.

This is a psalm for people going up to the temple to worship. It is a psalm of David. Yahweh, I am not a proud, haughty person. I do not concern myself with things that are too great or too amazing for me.
Instead, I have calmed myself, like a weaned child who rests {calmly} on {the breast of} his mother. Yes, my inner being is peaceful like that contented child.
Israelites, confidently expect Yahweh {to do good things for you}, now and forever!
This is a psalm for people going up to the temple to worship. Yahweh, think about {King} David and the many ways that he suffered.
He made a solemn promise to Yahweh, the Mighty God whom Jacob worshiped.
{He said,} “I will not go home or lie down on my bed to rest.
I will not allow myself to sleep at all
until I build a home for Yahweh, the Mighty God whom Jacob worshiped.”
Listen, we heard about the sacred chest in Ephrathah; we found it in the fields near Jaar (Kiriath-Jearim).
{We said}, “Let us go to the place where Yahweh lives; let us worship {before the sacred chest} where he rests his feet.”
Yahweh, come to the place where you will stay, together with the sacred chest that represents your powerful presence.
May your priests always do what is right, and may the people who are faithful to you shout joyfully.
Because of what you promised to David, who served you, do not reject the king whom you chose.
Yahweh swore a promise to David, and he will certainly not take it back: “I will place one of your own descendants {to rule as king} on your throne.
If your sons obey my covenant and the commands that I will teach them, then their sons will also rule as kings on your throne forever.”
Indeed, Yahweh has chosen Zion because he wanted it to be the place where he lives.
{He said,} “This is the place where I will stay forever; I will live here because I have chosen this place.
I will certainly give the people of Zion everything that they need; I will give enough food to satisfy {even} the poor people who live there.
I will enable the priests of Zion to show others what a person looks like whom I have saved, and the people there who are faithful to me will shout very joyfully.
In Zion I will cause a powerful king to come from David’s family; I have arranged for the king whom I have chosen that a son of his will always rule.
I will cause his enemies to be very ashamed, but his kingdom will prosper.”
This is a psalm for people going up to the temple to worship. It is of David. Think about how wonderful and delightful it is when God’s people live together {in a unified way}!
It is as delightful as {watching someone pour} fine olive oil on the head of Aaron, {the priest,} oil that runs down onto his beard and flows down to the collar of his robes.
It is as delightful as {feeling} the dew from Mount Hermon coming down on the mountains of Zion. That is where Yahweh blessed {his people}, giving them a way to live forever.
This is a psalm for people going up to the temple to worship. Listen! Praise Yahweh, all you who serve Yahweh, you who stand in Yahweh’s temple during the night hours.
Raise your hands {to pray toward} the holy place and praise Yahweh.
I pray that Yahweh will bless you from {his temple on} Mount Zion, {for} he is the one who made everything that exists.
Praise Yahweh! Praise him because of who he is! You who serve Yahweh, praise him,
you who stand {and serve} in Yahweh’s temple, in the courtyards of the house of our God!
Praise Yahweh, because he is good; sing praises to him, because doing that is delightful.
Praise him because Yahweh chose {us,} the descendants of Jacob, the people of Israel, to belong only to him.
Indeed, I know very well that Yahweh is great and that our Lord is more powerful than all other spirit beings.
Yahweh does whatever he wants to do, everywhere, whether it is in heaven or on the earth or in the ocean, even deep down in the ocean.
He causes clouds to form in distant places on the earth; he makes lightning flash along with the rain, and he sends out wind from the places where he stores it.
He killed every firstborn in Egypt, including those from both people and animals.
He did amazing miracles among the people of Egypt to punish Pharaoh and all of his officials.
He defeated many nations and killed their powerful kings.
He killed Sihon, king of the Amorites, and Og, king of Bashan, and all the kings of Canaan.
Then he gave the land that those kings had ruled over to his own people, that is, to {us,} the people of Israel, to be our own land.
Yahweh, people will always know how great you are; Yahweh, people in every generation will remember you,
because Yahweh defends his people and is merciful to those who serve him.
The idols that other people groups worship are only statues made of silver and gold; people made them with their own hands.
Those idols have mouths, but they cannot say anything; they have eyes, but they cannot see anything.
They have ears, but they cannot hear anything; In fact, they do not even breathe.
The people who make those idols will become as helpless as they are, and so will everyone who trusts in them.
You Israelites, praise Yahweh! You descendants of Aaron, praise Yahweh!
You descendants of Levi, praise Yahweh! All you who deeply revere Yahweh, praise him!
Praise Yahweh from his temple on Mount Zion, where he lives in Jerusalem! Praise Yahweh!
Thank Yahweh because he is good {to us}, because he faithfully loves {us} forever!
Thank God, the one who is greater than all other spirit beings, because he faithfully loves {us} forever!
Thank the Lord, the one who is greater than all other rulers; because he faithfully loves {us} forever!
{Thank} him, the only one who does wonderful miracles, because he faithfully loves {us} forever!
{Thank} him, the one who wisely created the heavens; because he faithfully loves {us} forever!
{Thank} him, the one who formed the earth over the waters; because he faithfully loves {us} forever!
{Thank} him, the one who created the great lights {in the sky}; because he faithfully loves {us} forever!
{He made} the sun to light up the daytime, because he faithfully loves {us} forever!
{He made} the moon and stars to light up the nighttime, because he faithfully loves {us} forever!
{Thank} him, who killed the firstborn {sons} of the Egyptians; because he faithfully loves {us} forever!
He brought the Israelite people out from among them, because he faithfully loves {us} forever!
He did that by being very powerful, because he faithfully loves {us} forever!
{Thank} him, the one who divided the Sea of Reeds into {two} parts; because he faithfully loves {us} forever!
He enabled the Israelite people to walk through the middle of it {on dry land}, because he faithfully loves {us} forever!
But he caused Pharaoh and his army to drown in the Sea of Reeds, because he faithfully loves {us} forever!
{Thank} him, the one who led his people {safely} through the desert, because he faithfully loves {us} forever!
{Thank} him, the one who defeated powerful kings, because he faithfully loves {us} forever!
He killed powerful kings, because he faithfully loves {us} forever!
{He killed} Sihon, the king of the Amorites, because he faithfully loves {us} forever!
{He killed} Og, the king of Bashan; because he faithfully loves {us} forever!
He gave their land to the people of Israel to possess; because he faithfully loves {us} forever!
{He gave it} to the people of Israel, who serve him, to be our own land, because he faithfully loves {us} forever!
He did not forget about us when our enemies were oppressing us, because he faithfully loves {us} forever!
He rescued us from our enemies, because he faithfully loves {us} forever!
He gives food to every living creature; because he faithfully loves {us} forever!
Thank God, who rules from heaven; because he faithfully loves {us} forever!
{After soldiers had taken us to} Babylon, we sat down by the rivers there, and we cried when we thought about {the temple on Mount} Zion {in Jerusalem}.
We hung our harps on the willow trees there {and did not play them}.

We did that because those who had captured us {and taken us} there demanded that we sing for them. They tormented us and told us to sing a joyful song. {They said,} “Sing for us one of the songs about Zion!”
{We thought}, “We are not able to sing {joyful} songs about Yahweh in this foreign land!”
If I ever forget about Jerusalem, may my right hand be unable {to play the harp}!
May my tongue and my mouth make me unable to sing if I forget about Jerusalem, or {even} if I do not consider that Jerusalem causes me to be more joyful than anything else does.
Yahweh, please punish the Edomites for what they did when the enemy destroyed Jerusalem. They shouted, “Completely tear it down to its foundations!”
Concerning the people of Babylon, who devastate {other nations}, How good it will be for the person who completely pays them back with what they did to us!
How good it will be for the one who seizes your babies and smashes them against the rocks!
This is a psalm of David. Yahweh, I sincerely thank you. In the presence of {idols of} other gods, I sing to praise you.

I bow down toward your sacred temple {to worship you} and I thank you because you faithfully love us and because we can trust you to do all that you have promised. You have given cause for people everywhere to honor you and what you have said more than anything else.
When I called out to you, you helped me; you enabled me to be brave and strong.
Yahweh, {someday} all the kings of this earth should praise you because they will have heard what you have said.
They should sing about what you have done because you are very glorious.
Yahweh, although you live in heaven, you take care of humble people. Proud people, however, you identify from far away.
Even when dangerous things happen all around me, you keep me safe. You rescue me from my enemies who are angry with me.
Yahweh, I know that you will continue to do what is good for me; Yahweh, you faithfully love {us} forever. Please do not abandon {us,} the people that you have made!
This is a note for the worship leader: This is a psalm of David. Yahweh, you have thoroughly examined me, and you know {me completely}.
You are the one who knows everything that I do, including when I sit and when I stand. Even from far away, you know what I am thinking.
You have examined in detail all of my movements, from the time I go out until I lie down, and you know intimately all of my habits.
Indeed, even before I say anything, Yahweh, you already know everything that I am going to say!
You guard me on every side, and you put your hand on me {to protect me}.
I am in awe that you know everything about me. I am not able to comprehend that.
There is nowhere I could go to get away from your Spirit! There is nowhere I could run to escape from your presence!
If I went up to heaven, you would be there. Even if I lay down in the place where dead people go, you would be there!
If I rose up and flew to where the sun rises in the east, or if I settled in the farthest place across the {western} sea,
even there you would guide me and you would keep me secure.
Even if I said, “Let the darkness completely overwhelm me, and the light around me turn to night,”
even darkness is not dark to you, and the night shines as bright as the daytime. For you, darkness and light are the same.
Indeed, you are the one who created my deepest inner parts; you formed me inside my mother’s womb.
I praise you because you made me in such an awesome and wonderful way. Everything that you do is wonderful! I know that very well.
You saw my bones when you made me in that hidden place. As you wove me together deep in the womb,
you saw me before I had any form. You wrote in your book each day that you had planned for me to live, before any of those days had even started.
God, the things that you think are very valuable to me! There are so many of them!

If I tried to count them, {I would not be able to do that, because} they are more than the grains of sand {on the earth}. {Every morning} I wake up, I am still with you, {and there are still more of them to count}.
God, I wish that you would kill all wicked people! I wish that all violent men would go away from me!
They say wicked things about you and plan evil things; your enemies misuse your name.
Yahweh, I certainly hate those who hate you, and I am disgusted with those who rise up against you.
I hate them completely; I consider them to be my enemies.
God, I invite you to search me and to know what I am thinking; please examine me and know what I worry about.
See if there is any harmful way in me, and teach me to live in the way that lasts forever.
Yahweh, please save me from evil people; protect me from people who want to attack me.
They are always planning how to do evil things, and every day they provoke fights.
They say things {to people} that hurt {them}; what comes from their mouths is as deadly as the venom of a viper. Selah
Yahweh, protect me from wicked people who want to harm me; keep me safe from violent people who have planned to destroy me.

Proud people are trying to destroy me. {It is as though} they have hidden a snare for me; {It is as though} they have spread out a net along my path; {It is as though} they have set traps to catch me. Selah
I say to you, “Yahweh, you are my God.” Yahweh, please listen to me as I plead with you to help me!
Yahweh, my Lord, you are the one who powerfully saves me; you have protected me during battles as though you had covered my head {with a helmet}.
Yahweh, do not give wicked people what they want; do not let their plans succeed, or they will become proud. Selah
As for the leaders of those who surround me, let the harmful things that they have said {to others} happen to them.
Pour burning coals on them! Throw them into a fire! Throw them into deep holes from which they will never get out!
Yahweh, please do not allow people who slander others to prosper in this land; Cause evil things to continually happen to violent people and destroy them.
Yahweh, I know that you do what is just and right for poor people.
People who do what is right will surely thank you, and they will live with you.
This is a psalm of David. Yahweh, I call out to you; please help me quickly! Please listen to me when I am calling out to you.

Please accept my prayer {as though it were} an offering of incense to you. Please accept me while I lift up my hands {to pray to you}, just as you accept the sacrifices that people offer to you each evening.
Yahweh, do not allow me to say things that are bad or wrong. Do not allow me to say those things as a sentry does not allow the wrong people to go through a doorway.
Prevent me from wanting to do anything that is wrong and from joining with wicked men when they want to do evil deeds. Do not even allow me to share in eating their delightful food!

It is all right if righteous people strike me because they are acting faithfully and kindly toward me to correct me. {If they do that, it will be as if they have honored me by} anointing my head with {olive} oil, and may I never refuse to accept it. but I am always praying that you will punish the wicked because of the wicked deeds that they do.
When their rulers are thrown down from the top of rocky cliffs, the wicked will hear what I am saying, and will know that what I am saying is right and good.
{They will say,} “Just as one scatters {clods of earth} when he breaks up the ground, {soon} our bodies will lie scattered on the way to the place where dead people are.”
But Lord Yahweh, I continue to rely on you. I ask you to protect me; please do not stop protecting my life!
People who do evil things are trying to trick me and destroy me. It is as though they have laid out snares and set traps for me. Please keep me safe from what they are trying to do to me.
I desire that wicked people fall together into the traps that they have set {to catch me}, while, for my part, I escape {from them}.
Yahweh, I cry out to you; I plead for you to help me.
I am complaining to you about {all of} my problems; I am telling you {all of} my troubles.
When I am very discouraged, you are the one who knows what I must do. As I go about my activities, {it is as though} my enemies have hidden traps along my path for me {to fall into}.
If you look to my right you will see that there is no one who watches over me. There is nowhere I can go to be safe, and no one cares what happens to me.
So Yahweh, I called out to you {to help me}; I said, “You are the one who protects me; you are all that I need while I am alive.”
Please listen to me while I call out to you {to help me} because I am very distressed. Save me from those who are making me suffer, because they are stronger than I am.

Please free me from those who are distressing me so that I may thank you. When you do that, the other righteous people will gather with me {to praise you together} because you will have fulfilled my request.

This is a psalm of David. Yahweh, please listen to me as I pray to you, pleading for you to help me! Because you are righteous and because you faithfully do what you have promised, please do what I am asking you to do for me!
Please do not judge me, your servant, because you know that there is no one alive who is completely innocent.
Please help me because my enemies have pursued me; they have completely defeated me. {It is as though} they have already put me in a grave like people who are dead for eternity.
So I am very discouraged; I feel very dismayed.
I remember what has happened previously; I think about all the things that you have done; I consider the {great} deeds that you have performed.
I lift up my hands to you {as I pray}; I need you, just as much as a very dry land needs water. Selah
Yahweh, I am absolutely despairing, so please answer me right now! Do not keep away from me because if you do that, I will {soon} be among those who descend to where the dead people are.
Every morning cause me to remember that you faithfully love me because I trust in you. show me the things that I should do because I depend on you for my life.
Yahweh, please save me from my enemies; I rely on you to protect me.
You are the God to whom I belong, so teach me to do what pleases you. I want your good Spirit to show me the best way to live.
Yahweh, please keep me alive because of who you are; because you are righteous, please rescue me from {the people who are} oppressing me!
I am one who serves you; so because you faithfully love me as you promised to do, please kill all of my enemies who want to kill me.
This is a psalm of David. I praise Yahweh, who protects me! He equips me to fight well in wars.
He is always faithful and kind to me. He keeps me safe and helps me escape from danger, as if he were my shield or a place where I could go to be safe. He enables me to rule other peoples.
Yahweh, people are so insignificant; it is amazing that you pay any attention to them!
People live for only a very short time, just as a mist or a shadow quickly disappears.
Yahweh, please come down from the sky and split open the mountains so that smoke pours from them.
Please send lightning bolts like arrows against my enemies to make them run away.
Reach down from heaven and rescue me from my enemies who are surrounding me like a dangerous flood. Save me from the power of these foreign people.
They say things that are not true and raise their right hands to swear oaths that are false.
God, I will sing a new song to you and play my ten-stringed harp to praise you,
because you are the one who saves kings and who rescues me, your servant David, from danger in battle.
Save me from the power of these foreign people. They say things that are not true and raise their right hands to swear oaths that are false.
Then our sons will be like strong plants that grow tall when they are young, and our daughters will be as beautiful and stately as pillars that craftsmen carve to decorate a palace.
May our barns overflow with many kinds of crops. May our sheep give birth to great numbers of lambs, yes, very great numbers as they graze in our pastures.
May our oxen be strong to pull plows. May no one break through our walls, may no one go into exile, and may no one cry out {in distress} in our city squares.
What a good life people have when these things happen for them! What a good life people have who worship Yahweh as their God!
This is a psalm of David. My God and king, I will proclaim that you are very great; I will praise you now and always.
I will bless you every day; I will praise you forever.
Yahweh, you are great, and people should praise you very much; no one can fully understand how great you are.
People of every generation will tell the next generation about what you have done; they will tell about your mighty deeds.
I will think about how very glorious and majestic you are, and I will think about your wonderful deeds.
People will talk about how powerful your awesome deeds are, and I will proclaim how great you are.
People will celebrate how very good you are, and they will sing joyfully about how righteous you are.
Yahweh acts kindly and mercifully; he does not quickly become angry, and he faithfully loves us very much.
Yahweh is good to everyone, and he acts mercifully toward everything that he has made.
Yahweh, all the creatures that you have made will praise you, and the people who are faithful to you will bless you.
They will tell others about how gloriously you rule as king and about how powerful you are,
so that all people will know about your mighty deeds and about how gloriously and majestically you rule.
You will never stop ruling as king; you will rule throughout every generation.
Yahweh sustains people who are in difficult circumstances, and he helps those who are struggling.
All creatures look to you expectantly, and you give them food when they need it.
You give generously and satisfy the desire of every living thing.
Yahweh does everything rightly; indeed, he acts faithfully in all that he does.
Yahweh is ready to help everyone who asks him for help when they do that sincerely.
He gives those who deeply respect him what they need. He responds to them when they call for help, and he rescues them.
Yahweh protects all those who love him, but he destroys wicked people.
I will always say things to praise Yahweh; I want all people always to praise him because he is so holy.
Praise Yahweh! I will praise Yahweh with my whole being.
I will praise Yahweh for as long as I am alive; Yes, I will sing to praise my God for the rest of my life.
Since no human being can save you, do not rely on your leaders.
When they die, their bodies decay and become soil again. When that happens, they can no longer carry out their plans.
Some people confidently expect Yahweh their God to help them. He is the God whom Jacob worshiped. He does help them, and they have a very good life.
He is the one who created the sky and the land. He also created the oceans and all the creatures that are in them. He always does what he has promised to do.
He defends people whom others oppress, and he provides food for people who are hungry. Yahweh frees people who are in prison.
Yahweh enables people who are blind to see again; Yahweh helps people who are struggling; Yahweh loves people who do what is right.
Yahweh protects foreigners; he preserves the property of orphans and widows, but he makes the plans of wicked people fail.
Yahweh will be the king forever; yes, the God of the people of Jerusalem will always reign. Praise Yahweh!
Praise Yahweh! Singing praises to our God is a good thing to do. He deserves it, and it makes us happy.
Yahweh is rebuilding Jerusalem and bringing back the Israelites whom our enemies had scattered.
He comforts people who are very sad and heals their pain.
He knows how many stars there are, and he has given each one its name.
Our Lord is great and very powerful; no one can measure how much he understands.
Yahweh helps humble people, but he makes wicked people fail in what they want to do.
Thank Yahweh, our God, for all he has done for us as you play the harp and sing to him.
He makes the sky form rain clouds so that they will rain on the earth and make grass grow on the mountains.
He provides food for wild animals. He even feeds young ravens when they cry out for food.
He does not value the strength of a horse or the speed of a human runner.
Instead, Yahweh values people who deeply respect him. He values people who confidently expect him to be faithful to his covenant promises.
Praise Yahweh our God, you people of Jerusalem who live on Mount Zion!
He has made the defenses of your city strong, and he has blessed the people who live among you.
He keeps your borders safe, and gives you plenty of wheat to eat.
He gives commands about what will happen on the earth, and these things happen right away.
He makes snow that covers the ground like a white wool blanket, and he scatters frost on the ground like ashes.
He hurls down hail like small stones. When he makes it cold, no one can stand outside.
But then he gives a command, and the snow and ice melt. He sends a warm wind, and the water flows again.
He told the descendants of Jacob how he wanted them to live. Yes, he gave decrees and laws to the Israelites.
He has not done this for any other nation; they do not know his laws. Praise Yahweh!
Praise Yahweh! You who are in heaven, praise Yahweh; yes, you who are in the highest places, praise him.
All you angels, praise him; all you heavenly armies, praise him.
Sun and moon, praise him; all you shining stars, praise him.
You highest heavens, praise him, and you waters above the sky, praise him.
Let all of these praise Yahweh, because he created them by his own command.
He set them in their places permanently; {to do that,} he made a decree that will always be in effect.
You who are on the earth, praise Yahweh! You great sea creatures and everything deep in the ocean,
lightning and hail, snow and clouds, and strong winds that obey what he commands,
all you mountains and hills, all you fruit trees and cedar trees,
all you wild animals and livestock, all you creatures that crawl on the ground and all you birds that fly in the sky,
you kings of the earth and all your peoples, you rulers and all you judges,
you young men and young women, you old people and children,
you should all praise Yahweh, because he alone is truly great. He is more glorious than everything on earth and in heaven.
He has made his people strong, and other nations respect them. His people are the Israelite people, who are close to him. Praise Yahweh!
Praise Yahweh! Sing a new song to Yahweh! Let his faithful people praise him when they gather together.
You Israelite people, God made you. Be happy because of what he has done for you. You people of Jerusalem, rejoice because God is your king.
Praise Yahweh by dancing. Play tambourines and harps to honor him.
Do that because Yahweh loves his people; he honors poor people by rescuing them.
God’s faithful people should celebrate because he has honored them. Even on their beds at night, they should praise him with joyful songs.
They should also shout loudly to praise God when they go into battle holding swords that have two sharp edges.
{They should be ready} to punish the people of other nations for the sins they have committed against God.
They should bind their kings with chains and put iron shackles on their leaders.
In that way, they will carry out the judgment that God has decreed against them. God will give his faithful people the honor {of doing that for him}. Praise Yahweh!
Praise Yahweh! Praise God in his temple here on earth, and praise him in the heavens that he created by his power!
Praise him for the mighty things he has done! Praise him because he is so very great!
Praise him by blowing horns loudly! Praise him by playing lyres and harps!
Praise him by beating tambourines and by dancing! Praise him by playing stringed instruments and flutes!
Praise him by playing loud cymbals and cymbals that make high notes!
Let everything that breathes praise Yahweh! Praise Yahweh!
